LESSON: DESCANT RECORDER

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.7: Descant Recorder
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Descant Recorder, part of Creating and Performing in Grade 9 CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS.

Key inquiry question: What is the importance of applying technique when playing instrumental music?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read, and interpret fingering charts to play the notes of F major scale,

2. play the scale of F Major ascending and descending on staff notation,

3. play simple melodies in the scale of F major on staff notation,

4. watch actual or virtual instrumental tutorials to demonstrate and explain techniques of pinching on a descant recorder,

5. explore actual or virtual demonstrations of playing techniques of descant recorder to explain performance directions for dynamics crescendo and diminuendo,

6. play simple melodies in 4 4 time, and in F major observing performance directions for dynamics,

7. use digital devices responsibly to record performances for future reference.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read, and interpret fingering charts to play the notes of F major scale,
2. play the scale of F Major ascending and descending on staff notation,
3. play simple melodies in the scale of F major on staff notation,
4. watch actual or virtual instrumental tutorials to demonstrate and explain techniques of pinching on a descant recorder,
5. explore actual or virtual demonstrations of playing techniques of descant recorder to explain performance directions for dynamics crescendo and diminuendo,
6. play simple melodies in 4 4 time, and in F major observing performance directions for dynamics,
7. use digital devices responsibly to record performances for future reference.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Descant Recorder together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-Efficacy: The learner confidently reads and interprets fingering charts as they play the notes of F major scale.

• Creativity and Imagination: The learner plays simple melodies in 4

Values:
• Responsibility: The learner acquires self-discipline as they use digital devices to record performances for future reference.

• Social justice: The learner and peers share roles fairly in executing musical duties towards playing the descant recorder.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Safety and security: The learner observes safety as they clean and play instruments.

• Self-awareness: The learner identifies skills they are good at and connect them with their talents in instrumental playing.

Link to other Learning areas:

• Integrated Science: The learner understands the science of sound production to enhance comprehension of playing

techniques, especially regarding the impact on the quality of sound.

• Pre-technical and Business Studies: The learner acquires concepts and procedures for understanding technical aspects in

assembling, playing, caring for and maintaining the Descant Recorder they play.
